sentences.text:
1 This is an application filed under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973, praying for quashing of a criminal proceeding and trial arising out of an FIR in connection with Hajo Police Station Case No.466/2020, registered under Sections 498A/307/377/511 of the Indian Penal Code and the Sessions Case No. 139/2022 which is pending before the Court of learned District &
Sessions Judge, Kamrup, Amingaon.

Mr. Medhi, learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that the matter has been already settled between the parties which arose only due to some misunderstanding and further he prays for stay of the criminal proceeding and trial arising out of an FIR in connection with Hajo Police Station Case No.466/2020.
In this context, Mr. Rahman, learned counsel for the respondent No.2 has sought for some time to file an affidavit-in-opposition.

Considering the submissions of learned counsels for both sides and also considering the facts and circumstances on the record, the criminal proceeding and trial arising out of an FIR in connection with Hajo Police Station Case No.466/2020, registered under Sections 498A/307/377/511 of the Indian Penal Code and the Sessions Case No. 139/2022 pending before the Court of learned Page No.# 3/3 District & Sessions Judge, Kamrup, Amingaon, stands stayed/suspended till returnable till returnable date.
